detail.longDescription: I am a huge fan of Elm, but the language is hard to use at work. Luckily, there are many implementations of TEA in other languages, so I created this website to help others find them. (A plug: this website uses react-tea-cup, a library that implements TEA and integrates well with React.) Website: https://tea.rinn7e.com/ Source code: https://github.com/rinn7e/tea-ecosystem
